```{=html}
<!-- Optional reader signup, landing page only. Posts to a Google Form the same
     way feedback-widget.html does. Fill the four constants below after creating
     the form (see SIGNUP-SETUP.md). Delete this file and the include in
     index.qmd to remove it; nothing else depends on it. -->
<div id="reader-signup" style="margin:2.5rem 0 0;padding:1.5rem 1.6rem 1.7rem;border:1px solid #dfe3e8;border-radius:6px;">
  <div id="rs-form-state">
    <h3 style="font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .4rem;color:#1F4E79;">Tell me you are reading</h3>
    <p style="font-size:.9rem;color:#5b6570;margin:0 0 1rem;line-height:1.55;">
      Optional, and the book stays open either way. If you would like to hear when
      chapters change, leave your details. I use them for that and nothing else.
    </p>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.7rem;">
      <input id="rs-name" type="text" placeholder="Name"
        style="flex:1 1 180px;padding:.55rem .7rem;border:1px solid #cdd4db;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem;box-sizing:border-box;">
      <input id="rs-email" type="email" placeholder="Email"
        style="flex:1 1 220px;padding:.55rem .7rem;border:1px solid #cdd4db;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem;box-sizing:border-box;">
    </div>

    <input id="rs-role" type="text" placeholder="Role or institution (optional)"
      style="width:100%;padding:.55rem .7rem;border:1px solid #cdd4db;border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem;box-sizing:border-box;margin-bottom:.9rem;">

    <label style="display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.85rem;color:#5b6570;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:1rem;cursor:pointer;">
      <input id="rs-consent" type="checkbox" style="margin-top:.2rem;flex:0 0 auto;">
      <span>I am happy to be emailed about changes to this book. I can ask to be removed at any time.</span>
    </label>

    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <button id="rs-submit" type="button"
        style="background:#1F4E79;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:.55rem 1.1rem;font:inherit;font-size:.92rem;cursor:pointer;">
        Send
      </button>
      <span id="rs-hint" style="font-size:.82rem;color:#8a929b;"></span>
    </div>

    <p style="font-size:.78rem;color:#8a929b;margin:1.1rem 0 0;line-height:1.5;">
      What is collected: the three fields above, and the date you sent them. What it is used for:
      telling you when the book changes. It is not shared, sold, or used for anything else, and it is
      deleted on request or when this edition is superseded. Ask at the address on the About page.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div id="rs-thanks" style="display:none;font-size:.95rem;color:#1F4E79;line-height:1.55;">
    Thank you. You will hear from me when a chapter changes materially, not otherwise.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ---- Fill these four after creating the Google Form. See SIGNUP-SETUP.md ----
  var FORM_ACTION  = "PASTE_FORM_ACTION_URL_HERE";
  var ENTRY_NAME   = "entry.PASTE_NAME_ID";
  var ENTRY_EMAIL  = "entry.PASTE_EMAIL_ID";
  var ENTRY_ROLE   = "entry.PASTE_ROLE_ID";
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  var box = document.getElementById("reader-signup");
  if (!box) return;

  // Until the form is wired up, hide the widget rather than showing a dead button.
  if (FORM_ACTION.indexOf("PASTE_") === 0) { box.style.display = "none"; return; }

  var name = document.getElementById("rs-name"),
      mail = document.getElementById("rs-email"),
      role = document.getElementById("rs-role"),
      ok   = document.getElementById("rs-consent"),
      btn  = document.getElementById("rs-submit"),
      hint = document.getElementById("rs-hint");

  function valid(v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); }

  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!valid(mail.value.trim())) { hint.textContent = "A valid email, please."; return; }
    if (!ok.checked) { hint.textContent = "Please tick the box so I know it is wanted."; return; }

    btn.disabled = true;
    hint.textContent = "Sending...";

    var body = new FormData();
    body.append(ENTRY_NAME,  name.value.trim());
    body.append(ENTRY_EMAIL, mail.value.trim());
    body.append(ENTRY_ROLE,  role.value.trim());

    fetch(FORM_ACTION, { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", body: body })
      .then(done).catch(done);

    function done() {
      document.getElementById("rs-form-state").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("rs-thanks").style.display = "block";
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
